name: Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fields (CROP)
definition: A framework that performs multi-view image super-resolution (MVSR) on train-view images during the radiance fields optimization process to improve high-resolution novel view synthesis (HRNVS). It fuses SISR features with voxel-based uncertainty fields to ensure multi-view consistency and high-frequency details.
summary: CROP is a framework that improves high-resolution novel view synthesis by iteratively refining training images using single-image super-resolution features and voxel-based uncertainty fields to ensure multi-view consistency.
